newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil by around $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, fuel oil by around $3.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Tuesday, fuel oil by most, dealers said.
Gasoline was up $1/$2 a tonne. One eurograde barge traded at $195 fob Rotterdam.

Heating oil gained about $1 as futures strengthened. Prompt offers remained at May IPE +$1 fob Rotterdam. Bids were from IPE May flat to +50 cents. Buying was weak. One major that has bought consistently for about a week was not in the market.
High sulphur fuel oil was around $3 a tonne higher as one major picked up refinery material at between $86 and $87 fob Rotterdam.
Traders said bunker demand appeared low, as on Monday.
